build_multiwoz_dataset: build the MultiWOZ 2.1 dataset by calling the build function to download and prepare data files
create_teacher_instance: create a MultiWozTeacher instance with an opt dictionary to load and serve MultiWOZ dialogue data
setup_dialogue_data: setup dialogue data by loading data.json and splitting into train, validation, and test sets
get_dialogue_example: get a dialogue example by episode and entry index returning text and labels from the conversation log
count_dialogue_examples: count the total number of dialogue turn examples across all conversations in the dataset
